title: “If the news controls your emotions, it’s already discipling you.”
paragraphs: “If the news controls your emotions, it’s already discipling you.”

Hindi lang tayo nalilito sa balita — hinuhubog na tayo nito. Every headline is fighting for your emotion before it offers truth. Galit muna, takot muna, kampi muna… bago facts. And slowly, hindi na natin namamalayan, mas kabisado pa natin ang talking points ng feed kaysa ang tinig ng Diyos. I’m not saying “don’t watch the news.” I’m saying don’t let the news disciple you. Because if we don’t slow down, pray, and discern, we won’t just be misinformed, we’ll be confidently wrong. And that’s the most dangerous place for a believer to stand.
Discernment is an act of worship.

“Test everything; hold fast what is good.”
— 1 Thessalonians 5:21
